title: Police, Airport Growth, Brackenridge Land Deals
summary:
*   **Community Policing Efforts:** Discussion centered on police organizational development and the ongoing status of community policing initiatives.
*   **New Airport Development:** Extensive updates on the Austin Bergstrom International Airport (ABIA) project, including construction schedules, cargo contracts, land parcel allocations, and environmental cleanup.
*   **Major Real Estate & Legal:** Confidential discussions were held regarding potential real estate transactions involving Brackenridge Hospital and pending litigation.
